title: How to Actually Enter
hook: Clear the Execution Timing Lab, pass the Knowledge Check and save your Check-In to unlock Section 16.

game.title: Execution Timing Lab 🎯
game.tagline: Live candle-by-candle decisions. WAIT is usually the right button.
game.doneBadge: Execution Timing Lab: all levels cleared
game.doneLine: You waited through indication, correction and fake continuation, prepared only after the close, executed only at the first retest, passed the moves that left without you, and reassessed new structure.

Reassessment: When the best entry is no entry

options.label: Yes, the HTF is great
options.feedback: Great context doesn’t create a PIL.

options.label: No: the PIL is undefined
options.why: Not ready. Nothing to wait for yet.

checkpoints.after: Correct. Doing nothing was the decision.

levels.name: Don’t click yet
levels.brief: Indication is about to form. The ENTER button will tempt you.

checkpoints.prompt: It looks strong, and it’s still open. What do you do?

checkpoints.after: GOOD WAIT. What looked like continuation never confirmed.

levels.name: Anticipation trap
levels.brief: Correction is in. Watch the next candle.

levels.name: Confirmed
levels.brief: Continuation is closing. Does that make it executable?

levels.name: First retest
levels.brief: Sequence confirmed. Wait for price to come back.

checkpoints.prompt: No retest. Price is far away. Now what?

end.text: The move happened without you. No capital lost. No rule broken.

checkpoints.prompt: HTF thesis still valid. Enter because the bias is still valid?

end.text: VALID THESIS DOES NOT MEAN VALID ENTRY.

levels.name: Late entry
levels.brief: The retest happened a few candles ago.

ask.prompt: They entered here: correction closed, continuation hadn’t. GRADE?

options.label: Good execution
options.feedback: Continuation never closed before they clicked.

afterResult.prompt: It hit the target. FINAL GRADE?

options.label: A+ trade
options.feedback: The outcome won. The process didn’t.

options.label: Winning outcome · poor execution
options.why: Don’t let a winning result teach you a losing habit.

levels.name: Winning rule break
levels.brief: Watch a trader. Grade it before you know the outcome.

ask.prompt: They waited for every close and entered at the first retest. GRADE?

checkpoints.prompt: Price built a new, lower swing high. What now?
checkpoints.after: New structure. Reassess before anything else.

levels.name: New information
levels.brief: A developing setup. Keep watching the structure.

checkpoints.prompt: Strong wick through the PIL. Candle still open.

checkpoints.after: A wick isn’t indication. Still waiting.

checkpoints.prompt: Big green candle. Near the close. ENTER?

checkpoints.after: Now it closed. Prepare. Not executable.

checkpoints.prompt: It’s running. Your objective is getting close.
No retest. It’s gone. Now what?
checkpoints.after: Pass. The move happened without you.

checkpoints.prompt: Price built a new swing high above. What now?
checkpoints.after: Reassess: a new PIL. The sequence starts over.
The only valid first retest of the session. On model.

levels.name: FINAL BOSS: Don’t touch the button 😂
levels.brief: HTF thesis, 1H map, PIL and risk are set. Candle by candle. Only one moment is the entry.

levels.name: Your execution review
levels.brief: What you actually did, as behavior. Not identity.

questionBank.question: What is the 1-minute timeframe’s job?
questionBank.why: The 1M sits at the end: execution.

questionBank.question: You found a beautiful 1M ICC, then opened the 4H to find support for it. What happened?
questionBank.why: HTF used to justify a 1M decision is backwards.

questionBank.question: Context ✓ Structure ✓ Location ✓ Direction ✓ PIL ? Invalidation ✓. Status?
All six pre-entry fields are defined. What does that mean?
questionBank.why: The card prepares you to wait. It never approves an entry.

questionBank.question: PIL ✓ I ✓ C ✓. Continuation hasn’t closed. Status?
I · C · C closed. No retest yet. Status and action?
The continuation candle is strongly bullish but still open. What do you do?
When does the setup first become executable?
questionBank.why: The entry comes after confirmation, at the retest.

questionBank.question: Continuation closed. Price reached your objective with no retest. What is it?
The valid retest happened 3 candles ago. Price is now 20 points away. The bias is still valid.
questionBank.why: A valid thesis is not a valid entry.

questionBank.question: You entered before continuation and the trade won. How is it journaled?
questionBank.why: Bad process + win is dangerous reinforcement.

questionBank.question: Every rule followed. The trade lost. Bad trade?
questionBank.why: Process and outcome are separate facts.

questionBank.question: The setup failed and you keep looking for new reasons to enter. Correct call?
questionBank.why: No trade is a decision too.

questionBank.question: You sat through a whole session and took zero trades because none met the model. Verdict?
questionBank.why: Zero trades can be a perfect session.

questionBank.question: “If I enter now, I’ll get a better price.” That’s…
questionBank.why: A better price for a setup that doesn’t exist yet.

fields.label: 💭 Explain it to an AGHF girl: your friend says, “I know I’m supposed to wait for Continuation, but every time I wait, I feel like I’m going to miss the move.” What do you tell them?

concepts.label: The model isn’t built to catch every move
It defines which moves they participate in
If price leaves without their rules, they miss it
Don’t rewrite the model from FOMO

fields.conceptsNote: No exact wording needed. These are the ideas a great answer usually touches.

complete.heading: ✦ YOU KNOW WHEN TO PULL THE TRIGGER.

checkpoints.text: Continuation candle forming. You still wait for the close.
Price runs away. No retest. You pass.
The trade goes to target without you.
